stem: Which action did the Allied powers take in response to what was described in this letter?

options.label: G
options.text: Began a bombing campaign to destroy key military bases

options.label: H
options.text: Charged Nazi officials with war crimes in the Nuremberg trials

options.label: J
options.text: Permitted Nazi officials to leave the country

visual_elements:
We have seen something here that overpowers the death of anyone back home. We have seen what can be called the living dead. Moving up into a new position we came across a prison camp. . . . We went out to see what a concentration camp looked like. . . . As we entered the camp the first thing we saw was the burned down buildings, but a little farther on we got the shock of our lives.

—Aaron A. Eiferman, member of the U.S. 12th Armored Division, letter to his wife, April 27, 1945
